tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List published blog articles from abelsalah.fr with title, slug, date, excerpt and tags. Covers AI strategy, sales automation, AI training and consulting insights (French).

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.title: Get blog post
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a published blog post on abelsalah.fr by slug (returns title, meta, sections and public URL).

slug.description: Slug of the blog post (from list_blog_posts).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.title: List consulting offers
tools.description: List Abel SALAH's consulting offers (AI audit, sales automation, AI training) with URL and short summary.
